George Fletcher lived next door to the Blythe family. He employed a hired man named [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) Buote, who worked on his property.

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/george-fletcher--gilbert-blythe.md)

George Fletcher is connected to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by marriage, as George's wife is Gilbert's aunt. While they share this family connection, [George](../character/george.md) does not directly feature in the events surrounding Gilbert's severe illness with typhoid fever and subsequent recovery.

- Relative of — wife is Gilbert's aunt  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P19](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0019)</sub>

### [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/george-fletcher--pacifique.md)

George Fletcher employs [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) Buote as his hired man. [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) acts in a service capacity within the community, such as delivering the news that Gilbert's dangerous fever has broken.

- Commands — hired man  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P19](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0019)</sub>
